ios.desc:
Do You Know Your Lingo?

Play the free word guessing game based on the hit TV gameshow - and guess as many words as you like, every single day.

The Word Game You Know From TV

If you’ve ever watched the show and wanted to play along, this is your chance! The rules are simple: we give you the first letter and you have 5 guesses to find the word. After each guess, we’ll show you which letters are in the right position and which ones appear in the word but need to move. Work through the clues, narrow it down, and find the Lingo!
It’s a game you can dip into for five minutes or lose yourself in for an hour - either way, you’re giving your brain a genuine workout.

A Word Puzzle Game - But Not Just One a Day

Unlike other word puzzle games that give you a single daily challenge and make you wait until tomorrow, Lingo lets you play as many rounds as you want, whenever you want. Sharpen your vocabulary and keep playing for as long as you like. That said, if you love a daily word challenge, we’ve got one of those too! Lingo Daily Word is a dedicated daily word puzzle - a fresh word every day to test your guessing skills. Build a daily word training habit that improves your vocabulary and keeps your brain sharp over time. Add Lingo to your daily routine, share your results with friends and find out who really has the best word knowledge.

Lingo Leagues - Matched to Your Level

Lingo Leagues put you up against players of a similar ability, so every league is genuinely competitive. As you play and complete word rounds, you’ll earn points and climb through the league tiers. Leagues reset regularly, giving you a fresh start and a new group to compete against. Whether you’re a casual player finding your feet or a word game veteran chasing the top spot, there’s a league that fits where you are right now.

Collect and Upgrade Your Letter Tiles

Lingo features a Letter Tile collection. The higher the level of your tiles, the more points they generate per game - so the more you play, the more every correct guess is worth. There’s always the next upgrade to work towards.

Go On a Hot Streak

Keep guessing correctly and you’ll activate Hot Streak - Lingo’s bonus mode that kicks in when you’re on a roll. String together enough correct words in a row and Hot Streak fires up, doubling your points and building progress towards a chest full of rewards. The more momentum you build, the more there is at stake with each new word!

Do you know your Lingo?

Play the free mobile word game based on the hit TV format! Get your daily word fix!

Lingo is a fast-paced and challenging word guessing game designed to test people of all ability levels!

Try your hand at guessing our Daily Word. They can be quite hard, and will test your word searching skills to the limit! Whether you find the Daily Word or not, be sure to share your guesses online or with your friends - who is the best you know at finding words?

Follow your Daily Word progress with stat counters that track your word finding skills. Each Daily Word offers a fresh challenge to come back for, so you never know what word you may find! Whether it’s easy or hard, see if you can keep your word streaks going!

Lingo Daily Word is a new mode that is separate to the main Gameshow version. You will be able to find words in both! Jump in and start your word search journey today!

The game follows the gameplay of the Lingo TV gameshow - we give you the first letter of the word and all you have to do is guess it! We’ll show you which letters are in the right place and which ones are in the wrong place to help you to find the word in 5 guesses! More coins and points are awarded for guessing the Lingo word quickest!

Lingo has kept TV fans from around the world entertained for over 30 years, and now it’s your turn to add your name to the list of Lingo winners!

Join others by taking part in Lingo Leagues and rising through the ranks as you play. Pit yourself against other fans of the show on your quest to the top. To help you solve the puzzle, make use of Boosters and upgrade your collectable Letter Tiles so they reward more points per game, don’t let those bigger words go to waste!

Train your brain to pick out the right words as you look to guess the word in as short a time as possible. The quicker you guess the Lingo, the bigger the win! Battle against the clock and scramble to find the word in as few guesses as possible. Become a Lingo word master! 

Did we mention Bingo? Just like in the original TV format we’ve included it in the new Lingo game!

quotes.text:
Wordle is cool in its simplicity and focus on 'once per day' but the mechanic is literally a clone of Lingo already (the UK gameshow version at least, which I think is also a clone of the American Lingo gameshow).

You can see the official apps here:
https://apps.apple.com/gb/app/lingo-official-mobile-game/id1564413692
https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=uk.co.twowaymedia.lingo

There's tonnes of clones of those too in both app stores.

I also made a web based version recently, with unlimited words and choice of words lengths between 4-8 characters.
